paragraphs: Mentioned in Taanit, chapter 4, halakhah 5 (source locator כ:): Chinena, father of Rav Yenta.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The heading is Bar Yenta, while the body calls Chinena the father of Rav Yenta. כ: is an additional source locator (20 followed by a colon); its correspondence to a particular page, column or modern reference has not been established here.

The heading Bar Yenta remains distinct from body Chinena, father of Rav Yenta; full Rav belongs to Yenta alone. Chapter4, halakhah5 is conventional. The additional -כ: is preserved as supplied; its20-plus-colon form does not independently establish a page, column or modern20b mapping. The older certified printed-page20b claim is qualified, and no exact Jerusalem Talmud edition is verified.
